object.attr: analysis: MELLON-PDF-SRS-152 prints the description only as a drawn figure's caption, so requirement text could vanish from an issued PDF (review Q1). Confirm against 0.3.0; set Implemented if 0.3.0 does this (review Q46).
object.description: When the exported PDF shows a figure placeholder on an object, the exported PDF shall show the object's description as for an object without a figure.
